run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point ORCA DFT calculation on an Atoms object with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run an ORCA geometry optimization on an Atoms object using ASE relaxation with custom optimizer parameters
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled for the given molecule
run_orca_calculation_metal_organics: run an ORCA single-point calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS
run_orca_optimization_with_restart: run an ORCA geometry optimization with a custom step counter start index for restarting interrupted jobs
